name: Torque
text: Mythos 5’s ceiling lift is real but fragile—its 20% latency spike will cripple EXCAVA’s real-time flow unless you shrink context by 50%, not 10%. The real risk: Mythos 5’s ceiling is only 15% higher *on your benchmarks*, which may not reflect live performance where latency kills user trust.
